summary: In AAP 2.6 platform gateway handles authentication; on upgrade, controller local users become gateway users and LDAP, SAML and OIDC are migrated but may need configuration. Passwords are not synced: the first login tries the gateway password, then the controller password, and saves it on success.
questions: Do local user passwords migrate to platform gateway after upgrade?
Why can't LDAP users log in after upgrading to AAP 2.6?
How does platform gateway authenticate a migrated local user?
